manual_boundary_reviews.check: Web reload is not successful history read
manual_boundary_reviews.boundary: Spinner, cancellation filtering or reload do not prove native history loaded, current-target completeness or service completion.
Web navigation cancellation differs from native history generation/request receipts; never merge stale text into a new target or erase receipts on cancel.
Match cancellation domains/codes; WebKitErrorDomain/102, 500ms recheck and 15s loop guard are not recovery/non-execution guarantees.
Preserve target, positions, references and gaps; no guessed references, rewritten timestamps/URLs or cross-account index.
All synthetic, no link fetch; stop when real authority/read/handled/remote receipts are unknown. Destinations may save/sync; no blind replay.
